# Inventive HQ

> > Inventive HQ provides cybersecurity, managed IT services, and cloud solutions with expertise in AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, API security, and compliance frameworks like HIPAA and FERPA.

Inventive HQ delivers enterprise-grade cybersecurity consulting, cloud infrastructure management, and technical guidance for organizations across education, healthcare, and business sectors. The site features in-depth technical guides on API development, cloud security, disaster recovery, and compliance best practices.

## Key Topics

- AWS (Amazon Web Services)
- Azure
- Google Cloud
- API Security
- HIPAA Compliance
- Disaster Recovery
- Cloud Security
- Web Security

- DevOps

- Cross-Region Replication
- Data Protection
- Cybersecurity for CEOs
